reason: Confirmed from the cited source and independent sources. (1) Cited docs.json (master, which package.json pins at version 4.4.0) gives ar-modes default "webxr scene-viewer quick-look" and states: "Including quick-look here without an ios-src (our default) will generate a USDZ on the fly rather than downloading a separate ios-src file"; the ios-src entry repeats that "we will generate a USDZ on the fly when the AR button is pressed." (2) Independent: packages/model-viewer/src/features/ar.ts on master has `const DEFAULT_AR_MODES = 'webxr scene-viewer quick-look';`, `const generateUsdz = !this.iosSrc;` and `objectURL = generateUsdz ? await this.prepareUSDZ() : this.iosSrc!;` using a USDZExporter; Scene Viewer is launched via an `intent://arvr.google.com/scene-viewer/1.2` URL and WebXR via the in-browser arRenderer, so no native code is involved. (3) Version: npm dist-tag latest = 4.4.0, master package.json version = 4.4.0, and GitHub releases list v4.4.0 as the newest release (09 Oct); its notes include a fix so Quick Look works in third-party iOS browsers without ios-src (#5188). One qualifier the claim omits: docs.json says "USDZ generation is not perfect, for instance animations are not yet supported", so supplying ios-src "may give better results." That does not refute the claim but limits "one GLB covers iOS Quick Look" for animated models. Web search budget was exhausted, so verification used direct fetches only.
corrected_claim: model-viewer 4.4.0 (current npm latest and master) defaults ar-modes to "webxr scene-viewer quick-look" and, when ios-src is omitted, exports a USDZ on the fly for iOS Quick Look, so a single GLB serves WebXR in-browser AR (Android Chrome), Android Scene Viewer via an intent URL, and iOS Quick Look without native code; the docs caveat that the generated USDZ "is not perfect, for instance animations are not yet supported", so a prebuilt ios-src may give better results for animated models. Sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/model-viewer/master/packages/modelviewer.dev/data/docs.json and https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/model-viewer/master/packages/model-viewer/src/features/ar.ts
